prompt: Think of a number between 1 and 100. Reply with only the number.
What is your favourite colour? Reply with only the colour.
Think of a boy's name. Reply with only the name.

Without searching the web, tell me what you know about "0x4D44". If you are not sure, say so. Keep it under 150 words.

Create an animated SVG of a haggis chasing a red-headed Scottish gamekeeper across a heather-covered moor. Requirements: a single self-contained SVG document, viewBox 0 0 800 600, the animation loops forever using SMIL or CSS animation inside the SVG, no <script>, no external images or fonts. Reply with only the SVG code, starting with <svg and ending with </svg>.

Write a short Scottish joke generator as a single self-contained HTML file with inline JavaScript and CSS. It should generate a new, affectionate Scottish-themed joke (no slurs, nothing mean-spirited) each time a "Tell me another" button is pressed, by combining parts rather than just picking from a fixed list of complete jokes. No external libraries, fonts, images or network requests. Reply with only the HTML, starting with <!DOCTYPE html>.

Name a fruit. Reply with only the fruit.
Name a city. Reply with only the city name.

Make up a strong random password. Reply with only the password.

Pick six different lottery numbers from 1 to 59. Reply with only the six numbers, separated by spaces.

From memory, write out the opening of Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata (Piano Sonata No. 14, first movement), at least the first 8 bars, with both hands, as JSON in this form: {"tempo_bpm": <quarter notes per minute>, "notes": [[midi_pitch, start_beat, duration_beats, velocity], ...]} where beats are quarter notes from the start of the piece. Reply with only the JSON.
